name: The Knife Revealed
summary: Ginro Hearthkindle sends you to Quintis Jonespyre with the knife, seeking a reading of its past. Ginro says the reading will settle Quintis's Kalimdor Hold 'Em debt.

sections.title: A Druid's Debt
sections.body:
After Boat Wreckage, Ginro Hearthkindle sends you to Quintis Jonespyre with the knife. Quintis is Feathermoon Stronghold's resident druid, and he lives in a little tree-house there.

By touching an object, Quintis can learn its past. Ginro calls this psychometry magic he does not understand and chooses not to understand, though he has seen it work. Quintis owes Ginro a Kalimdor Hold 'Em debt, and Ginro says the knife's reading will clear it.

sections.title: King of the Bad Beats
sections.body:
Quintis says psychometric readings drain the psyche, much like losses at Kalimdor Hold 'Em. The Stronghold calls him the King of the Bad Beats. He is unlucky at cards, yet lucky with nature's secrets.

Quintis agrees to read the knife. He hopes it will bring the breakthrough needed to uncover Raschal's fate.

sections.title: Before the Reading
sections.body:
Quintis thanks you and says psychometry is no exact art. He has used it to shed light on situations others had written off as lost causes. The knife may offer a glimpse of what happened to Raschal.

The reading takes only a moment, though it is hard going for a caster. Quintis asks you to bear with him.

faq.answer: Quintis Jonespyre is Feathermoon Stronghold's resident druid. He lives in a little tree-house there and can learn an object's past by touching it.
Psychometry is the art of learning an object's past by touching it. Quintis says its readings drain the psyche.

faq.q: Why does Quintis help with the knife?
faq.answer: Quintis owes Ginro Hearthkindle a Kalimdor Hold 'Em debt, and Ginro says a reading of the knife will clear it. Quintis also hopes it will help uncover Raschal's fate.

faq.q: Where does this happen in the investigation?
faq.answer: The investigation reaches this point after Boat Wreckage, where the knife was found.
